articles.description: Thirty years after "Space Jam," those who shared the summer with Jordan remember the basketball that unfolded offscreen.

images.caption: Jordan's supporting cast extended beyond the Looney Tunes, with NBA stars filling a custom-built gym on the Warner Bros. lot.

article.headline: Los Angeles plays Phoenix, looks for 5th straight road win
article.description: Los Angeles Lakers (11-2, second in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (5-6, 11th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Los Angeles plays Phoenix, looks for 5th straight road win
article.linkText: Los Angeles plays Phoenix, looks for 5th straight road win
article.story: Los Angeles Lakers (11-2, second in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (5-6, 11th in the Western Conference) Phoenix; Sunday, 4 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles will try to keep its four-game road win streak intact when the Lakers play Phoenix. Phoenix went 45-37 overall, 29-23 in Western Conference action and 25-16 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Suns averaged 9.5 steals, 4.2 blocks and 13.5 turnovers per game last season. Los Angeles went 53-29 overall, 10-7 in Pacific Division play and 25-16 on the road a season ago. The Lakers averaged 25.9 assists per game on 42.0 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Suns: Mark Williams: out (shoulder). Lakers: Austin Reaves: day to day (heel), Quentin Grimes: day to day (finger), Luka Doncic: day to day (ankle). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
